name: AirGuitar_1
short_caption: The robot plays a brief, playful air guitar solo, tilting its head and swaying its body.
movement_description: Starting from neutral, the robot lifts both arms, positioning its left hand as if holding a guitar neck and its right hand as if strumming. It sways its torso side-to-side and tilts its head dynamically, mimicking a rock performance while rapidly moving its right hand in a strumming gesture. Finally, it raises its left arm slightly in a mini-crescendo before lowering both arms back to its sides and returning its head to the neutral forward-facing posture.
safety_notes: The robot performs rapid, asymmetric arm movements and side-to-side torso swaying; ensure a clear lateral clearance radius of at least 1 meter to avoid colliding with nearby objects or visitors.
